title: Chicken & Rice Delight
instructions: Cut chicken into pieces and marinate with turmeric, red chili powder, and salt.
Heat oil or ghee in a deep pan.
Add cumin seeds, then sauté onions and garlic until golden.
Add marinated chicken and cook until browned.
Stir in soaked basmati rice and mix well.
Add water, cover, and cook on low heat until rice and chicken are done.
Garnish with chopped coriander and serve hot.

title: Paneer Butter Masala
instructions: Sauté onions and tomatoes in butter.
Season with garam masala and simmer.
Serve hot with naan or rice.

title: Dal Tadka
instructions: Prepare tadka with ghee, garlic, onion, and tomato.

title: Aloo Gobi
instructions: Add spices and cook until tender.

title: Vegetable Pulao
instructions: Sauté onions and spices in ghee.
Add water and cook until rice is done.

title: Dhokla
instructions: Mix gram flour, yogurt, and lemon juice.
Prepare tempering with mustard seeds and curry leaves.

title: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
Sauté onion and garlic in a pan.
Add ground beef and cook until browned.
Pour in tomato sauce and simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Classic Pancakes
instructions: Mix flour, baking powder, and sugar in a bowl.
Whisk in milk and egg until smooth.
Pour batter onto a hot griddle.
Cook until bubbles form, then flip.

title: Beef Tacos
instructions: Cook ground beef in a skillet.
Top with lettuce, cheese, and salsa.

title: Tomato Basil Soup
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in a pot.
Stir in fresh basil and serve.

title: Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Add cooked rice, peas, and carrots.
Add soy sauce and mix well.

title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Butter one side of each bread slice.
Place cheese between bread slices, buttered side out.
Grill in a pan until golden brown on both sides.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Chop lettuce and place in a bowl.
Drizzle with Caesar dressing and toss.

title: Lemon Garlic Salmon
instructions: Place salmon on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil, lemon juice, and minced garlic.

title: Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Sauté onion and mushrooms in a pan.
Add rice and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in parmesan cheese and serve.

title: Greek Salad
instructions: Chop cucumber, tomato, and red onion.
Combine in a bowl with feta cheese and olives.
Drizzle with olive oil and toss.

title: Veggie Stir Fry
instructions: Add vegetables and stir fry for 5-7 minutes.
Serve hot with rice or noodles.
